title: Website Audit & SEO Strategy
shortDesc: We start with a complete website audit to identify opportunities, fix issues, and create a strategy tailored to your goals.
overview: Every effective SEO campaign starts with knowing exactly where you stand. We run a full audit of your site's technical health, content, backlink profile, and competitive landscape, then translate those findings into a prioritized, custom strategy built around your business goals rather than a one-size-fits-all checklist.
benefits: A clear, prioritized roadmap instead of guesswork
Early identification of issues holding back your rankings
A strategy tied directly to your business goals
A benchmark to measure future progress against

process.desc: We learn your business, goals, and target audience.
We review technical health, on-page content, and backlinks.
We see where you stand against the businesses you're competing with.
You get a prioritized action plan built for your goals.

title: On-Page Optimization
shortDesc: From keyword research to meta tags, headings, and content improvements, we optimize every page for search engines and users.
overview: On-page optimization makes sure every page on your site is working as hard as it can. We research the keywords your customers are actually searching for, then refine titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and content so each page is built to rank and to convert.
benefits: Pages built around real customer search terms
Improved click-through rates from better titles and descriptions
Stronger internal linking and site structure
Content that serves both search engines and real readers

process.desc: We find the terms your customers are searching for.
We review titles, headings, meta tags, and content.
We rewrite and restructure pages for clarity and relevance.
We track rankings and refine as results come in.

title: Technical SEO
shortDesc: Fast-loading, mobile-friendly, and error-free websites perform better in rankings. We handle site speed, indexing, structured data, and technical fixes.
overview: Search engines reward sites that are fast, crawlable, and free of errors. We dig into your site's technical foundation, fixing indexing issues, improving load times, cleaning up structured data, and making sure your site works flawlessly on every device.
benefits: Faster load times that keep visitors on your site
Improved crawlability and indexing by search engines
Structured data that helps you stand out in search results
A mobile experience that meets modern ranking standards

process.desc: We scan your entire site for errors and blockers.
We test performance across devices.
We add schema markup where it helps you stand out.
We resolve issues and keep watching for new ones.

title: Local SEO
shortDesc: Get found by customers near you! We optimize your Google Business Profile, local citations, and location-based keywords so you dominate local searches.
overview: Most customers start their search close to home. We optimize your Google Business Profile, build consistent local citations, and target location-based keywords so your business shows up when nearby customers are ready to buy.
benefits: Higher visibility in local map pack results
A fully optimized, up-to-date Google Business Profile
Consistent business listings across the web
More foot traffic and local phone calls

process.desc: We build out your Google Business Profile fully.
We create consistent listings across local directories.
We optimize pages around location-based searches.
We help you build and manage local reviews.

title: Content Creation & Optimization
shortDesc: We create and optimize high-quality content that targets the right keywords, answers your customers' questions, and establishes your brand as an industry authority.
overview: Content is how you earn trust and rankings at the same time. We create and refine content that answers the real questions your customers are asking, targets the keywords that matter, and positions your brand as the authority in your space.
benefits: Content built around real customer questions
Stronger topical authority in your industry
More organic traffic from long-tail keywords
Content that supports every stage of the buyer journey

process.desc: We find what your audience is actually asking.
We write content that's helpful, clear, and on-brand.
We optimize structure, keywords, and formatting.
We track what's working and refine the rest.

title: Link Building & Authority Growth
shortDesc: We build high quality backlinks that increase your website's credibility and push you higher on search engines.
overview: Backlinks remain one of the strongest ranking signals search engines use. We earn high-quality, relevant links from credible sources, building your site's authority the right way — no shortcuts or spammy tactics that put your rankings at risk.
benefits: Increased domain authority and trust
Higher rankings for competitive keywords
Referral traffic from reputable sites
A safe, sustainable link profile

process.desc: We review your current backlink profile.
We identify relevant, high-authority link opportunities.
We earn quality links through outreach and content.
We track authority growth and remove toxic links.

title: Tracking & Reporting
shortDesc: You'll receive transparent reports that show keyword rankings, traffic growth, and ROI. No fluff, just results.
overview: You should always know exactly what your SEO investment is producing. We track keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and ROI, and deliver clear, transparent reports so you can see precisely what's working and why.
benefits: Full transparency into rankings and traffic
Reports tied to real business outcomes, not vanity metrics
Regular check-ins to review progress
Data-driven adjustments to your strategy over time

process.desc: We set up analytics and rank tracking correctly.
We deliver clear reports on rankings and traffic.
We walk through what's working and what's next.
We adjust the plan based on real data.

title: Competitor Analysis
shortDesc: We keep an eye on what your competitors are doing online tracking their keywords, backlinks, and strategies so we can position your business a step ahead.
overview: Knowing what your competitors are doing is often the fastest way to find your own opportunities. We track their keywords, content, and backlinks, uncovering gaps and openings you can use to move ahead of them in search results.
benefits: A clear picture of the competitive landscape
Keyword and content gaps you can capitalize on
Insight into competitor backlink strategies
A strategy built to outrank, not just keep pace

process.desc: We identify who you're really competing with online.
We find what they rank for that you don't.
We study where their authority comes from.
We turn findings into a clear action plan.
